courses.summary: 以金銀鉛鋅多產品礦山為例，避免把不同金屬、精礦及含水基準混為一談。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A gold-silver-lead-zinc multi-product case keeps different metals, concentrates and moisture bases distinct. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
